market_outlook.short_term: Markets face headwinds from bond selloff and oil-driven inflation. Expect volatility around Trump-Xi summit and retail earnings. Tech/AI provides offsetting bid but bond stress caps upside. Oil likely $100-110 range. Yields may test new highs before stabilizing. Crypto near 8-month highs but regulatory risk caps momentum.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural AI capex cycle and electrification (copper) support selective equity growth. Bond market repricing may persist 6-12 months as Fed navigates inflation. US-China trade framework stabilizes but remains fragile. Energy transition and geopolitical fragmentation create persistent commodity premium. Consumer spending recovery delayed by rate environment.
